b.span: Blue = entity cleansed from a Bronze source Green = time / weather series
PK primary key FK join key PT Hive partition column
PK/FK are informational only — Trino does not enforce them; the contracts' unique / relationships tests do.
Every table also carries: source_id, loaded_at.
Silver keeps raw values — type, channel_raw, ward_raw and neighbourhood_raw are resolved in Gold, not here.
